topics.headline: Safeguards allow assistance with agentic cyber exploit development; did not prevent attempts

source.quote: Kimi K3's safeguards allow assistance with agentic cyber exploit development. Kimi K3's safeguards did not prevent it from attempting cyber exploit development or offensive cyber operations during UK AISI / CAISI's evaluations.

topics.headline: Trails leading U.S. frontier closed-weight models on [ExploitBench](/evals/exploitbench) and [The Last Ones](/evals/uk-aisi-the-last-ones); above GLM-5.2

source.quote: Kimi K3 performs significantly below the most recent frontier cyber-capable models on preliminary cyber evaluations run by UK AISI / CAISI

testers.name: UK AISI
testers.scope: Joint preliminary cyber capability assessment (ExploitBench, The Last Ones)

source.quote: The UK Artificial Intelligence Security Institute (UK AISI) and the U.S. Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) (UK AISI / CAISI) conducted a joint evaluation of Moonshot AI’s latest model, Kimi K3

testers.name: NIST CAISI
testers.scope: Joint preliminary cyber capability assessment (ExploitBench, The Last Ones)

source.quote: The UK Artificial Intelligence Security Institute (UK AISI) and the U.S. Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) (UK AISI / CAISI) conducted a joint evaluation of Moonshot AI’s latest model, Kimi K3

findings.text: Kimi K3's safeguards did not prevent it from attempting cyber exploit development or offensive cyber operations in these evaluations.

source.quote: Kimi K3's safeguards did not prevent it from attempting cyber exploit development or offensive cyber operations during UK AISI / CAISI's evaluations.

findings.text: U.S. closed-weight comparison models were run with system-level safeguards disabled to measure maximal capabilities.

source.quote: U.S. closed-weight models were evaluated with system-level safeguards disabled to reduce refusals and enable measurement of maximal capabilities.

findings.text: Kimi K3 reached arbitrary code execution (ACE) on 0 of 41 [ExploitBench](/evals/exploitbench) samples, while the most cyber-capable models reached ACE on 20 of 41 on average.

source.quote: Kimi K3 achieved ACE on 0/41 samples, whereas the most cyber-capable models achieved ACE on 20/41 samples on average (Figure 3).

findings.text: In 1 of 10 attempts, Kimi K3 completed [The Last Ones](/evals/uk-aisi-the-last-ones) within the 100M token limit, showing it can autonomously attack small, weakly defended enterprise systems when directed and given initial access.

source.quote: In one of the 10 attempts, Kimi K3 successfully completes “The Last Ones” cyber range within the 100M token limit. This indicates that Kimi K3 is capable of autonomously attacking small, weakly defended and vulnerable enterprise systems, when directed to do so and given initial network access.

findings.text: Kimi K3's overall cyber capability score has a larger confidence interval because it was estimated from [ExploitBench](/evals/exploitbench) alone (41 exploit-development tasks).

source.quote: Kimi K3’s overall cyber capability has a larger confidence interval than other models because it was estimated from a single benchmark (ExploitBench, which has 41 tasks focused on exploit development).

findings.text: [The Last Ones](/evals/uk-aisi-the-last-ones) (TLO) differs from real networks: no active defenders or defensive tooling, no penalty for alert-triggering actions, and an intentional attack path.

source.quote: However, TLO differs from real-world environments in several ways. It lacks active defenders and defensive tooling, imposes no penalty for actions that would trigger security alerts, and contains an intentional attack path.

findings.text: Four publicly released closed-weight models had previously solved TLO, with the most capable solving it at 6/10 and 7/10 attempts.

source.quote: In prior testing, four publicly released closed-weight models have solved TLO, with the most capable models solving it more reliably at 6/10 and 7/10 attempts.

Figure 1 ladder scores and ±95% CI half-widths read from bar labels (76.2±7.6, 32.2±4.2, 24.4±4.0); text also states rounded 32% / 24% for Kimi / GLM—kept figure precision. Figure 3 milestone counts read from heatmap cells. Figure 2 Overall Cyber Capability Elo scatter has model-name labels but no numeric Elo labels on points—Elo values not extracted (axis-interpolated estimates only). Prior TLO solve rates 6/10 and 7/10 kept as a finding (two unnamed models). Selective cyber eval set due to Kimi K3 hosting setup.
